items.title: Q1 earnings beat expectations
items.body: The company reported revenue of $1.2B, up 15% year over year. CFO Jordan Kim cited strong enterprise adoption of the data platform and a 40% renewal rate lift on multi-year contracts. Guidance for Q2 was raised by 3% at the midpoint.

items.title: New product launch
items.body: The data platform beta opened to 100 enterprise customers last week. Early feedback centered on the automated schema migration tooling, which several design partners called out as the reason they signed. General availability is targeted for late Q3 with pricing expected to land within 20% of the existing tier.

items.title: Leadership change
items.body: VP of Engineering Priya Shah announced her departure after four years; she will stay on through the end of the quarter to support the transition. The replacement search is underway and will be led by an external retained firm. Interim leadership will rotate among the three existing engineering directors.

items.title: Security certification renewed
items.body: The company completed its annual SOC 2 Type II audit with zero exceptions for the third consecutive year. The report covers security, availability, and confidentiality criteria across all production systems. Customers can request the updated report through the trust center.
